children.value: > Fact From Story The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story SBF is on trial for alleged fraud and money laundering while leading crypto exchange FTX and sister company Alameda.
> > > Fact From Story FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Fraud involves intentional deception for financial gain.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Fraud and conspiracy are crimes.
> Commonsense Knowledge A trial is a process to determine whether someone is guilty of a crime.
